title: Parent-KL conservative actor tail recovery
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: A short optimizer-continuous actor tail regularized directly to the externally strongest parent at KL coefficient 0.1 can retain statistically reliable league improvement while avoiding destructive continuation drift.
material_change: Unchanged zero-hand recovery of v6-parent-kl-conservative-tail-20260901 with the required experiment-local run_tail.py provenance path; resume parent to 196608 physical hands with parent KL reference 0.1 and all other training factors fixed.

result.summary: The unchanged zero-hand recovery completed a 65064-hand parent-KL actor tail, preserved continuity, and passed the internal greedy mechanism gate with independent review.
result.conclusion: Direct parent KL coefficient 0.1 held terminal reference KL to 0.00119 while treatment beat parent by +47.59 bb/100 on the five training opponents with paired CI lower +8.60 and 4/5 positive anchors. This is not generalization evidence.
result.next_step: Before any Slumbot allocation, replay the treatment and parent on an audited outcome-free state corpus; admit live testing only if greedy disagreement and TV remain substantially below the failed weak-KL tail while all identities pass.
